purpose: Boundary-driven native bulk/cohesive coupling spike on one predeclared central interface; no free crack-path, calibration, mesh-convergence, or fragment qualification claim.

central_interface.insertion: intrinsic at initialization; no extrinsic insertion

bulk_resolution.resolution_interpretation: UNDER_RESOLVED for physical process-zone or crack-path claims; the 96-tet mesh is retained only for a bounded coupling/observation spike.

cohesive.delta_c_relation: delta_c = 2 * G_c / sigma_c_input; the bilinear law rescales its internal sigma_c_eff so the elastic branch reaches sigma_c_input at delta_0 and softens to zero at delta_c.
cohesive.initial_tangent_derivation: K_n = sigma_c_input / delta_0; K_t = (beta^2 / kappa) * K_n. beta=3 and kappa=1, so K_t=9*K_n. These are source-derived pre-peak opening/sliding slopes, not separate user-specified stiffness parameters.
cohesive.native_tangent_api_policy: Do not use the cohesive tangent API as the exact initial force derivative without resolving its sigma_c versus sigma_c_eff behavior; assemble the source-derived bilinear slopes directly for the stability bound.

boundary_conditions.loading: smooth half-cosine prescribed z displacement on the physical top boundary; all other top translations remain free
boundary_conditions.bottom: prescribe z = 0 on physical bottom boundary; x/y remain free except for the minimum in-plane rigid-mode pins
boundary_conditions.interface_and_bulk: No interface DOF is prescribed. Every cohesive-side DOF and every bulk DOF away from the top/bottom z constraints and three pin components is free.
boundary_conditions.boundary_node_identity: Read input physical triangle groups and carry source IDs through native bulk element ID + local vertex ordinal; no nearest-coordinate mapping. Coordinates are only an exact rest-state consistency check.

loading.mode: boundary-driven Mode-I opening with native bulk equilibrium and intrinsic cohesive interface
loading.bulk_stable_step_gate: Read getStableTimeStep() after native cohesive insertion; the reviewed implementation loops only regular bulk elements. Require dt <= 0.03 * this bulk-only value as a bulk sanity check; it is not a total cohesive-plus-bulk CFL gate.

stability.method: Independent initial K_bulk + K_cohesive against lumped M bound over all free DOFs, supplied and reviewed by the parent agent; no native cohesive-CFL API is assumed.
stability.gate: Before solver step 1 require an established parent-reviewed whole-system lambda_max upper bound and dt <= fraction_limit * 2/sqrt(lambda_max_upper_bound_per_s2). Until then the source runner must stop before the first solver step.

tractions.sign: native energy-conjugate sign for opening; retain raw components

quadrature_observation.layout: Require raw native arrays of shape (24, components), retain all three integration-point rows for every cohesive triangle, and reshape element-major to (8, 3, components) without cell averaging. Element-major quadrature ordering is an explicit contract to be checked against native connectivity and source API during the authorized run.
quadrature_observation.history: Save every post-solve step plus the initialized state. Keep raw signed values, no absolute-value or sign correction.

energy_contract.native_sign_policy: Record every getEnergy value and traction-opening dot product raw-signed. The inspected Akantu v5.0.7 MaterialCohesive::updateEnergies uses +0.5 * delta_opening dot (traction + previous_traction), so traction is energy-conjugate to opening; a simultaneous side-orientation reversal of both leaves the dot product unchanged. Prior extrinsic runs' negative native dissipated values are not explained by a traction sign flip. Preserve any negative value and fail its diagnostic gate; never apply abs() or clamp it.
energy_contract.native_energy_history_check: Independently integrate raw quadrature traction/opening increments with positive rest-area weights. Compare cumulative signed interface work against native dissipated + reversible energy. A mismatch or negative native dissipated energy is a diagnostic failure, not a sign-corrected PASS. getEnergy reads stored material energy in the inspected v5.0.7 source; each native key is queried once per post-solve state.
energy_contract.solver_history_lifecycle_review: Checked-in source confirms model afterSolveStep forwards to constitutive materials and energy getters read/copy current fields; the bundled source omits TimeStepSolver/savePreviousState implementation, so exact pre/post snapshot ordering remains unverified and must be tested by the independent native history identity.
energy_contract.negative_native_dissipation_tolerance_de: A raw value below -1e-12 J fails; values within the predeclared roundoff floor remain signed and visible in raw history.
energy_contract.actuator_force_definition: Record raw sums of mass*acceleration, internal force, and external force on top z constraints. actuator_reaction_estimate = sum(mass*acceleration - internal_force - external_force) using the predeclared residual convention; this is a diagnostic estimate and retains all three source arrays/sums.
energy_contract.actuator_work: positive actuator-work estimate: trapezoidal integral of the declared top constrained reaction estimate against commanded top z displacement; diagnostic only, independent of the cohesive interface work ledger.
energy_contract.cohesive_traction_opening_work: Retain raw signed native traction dot opening and cumulative integral of native tractions dot delta(opening) over each positive rest-area parent facet/quadrature point. The native energy-conjugate sign is retained; no negative sign is applied.
energy_contract.energy_balance: report W_actuator_estimate - (K + bulk potential + native reversible + native dissipated + native cohesive contact) with every native term raw-signed; diagnostic only, not an automatic PASS criterion. Independently report W_interface_native - (native reversible + native dissipated) as the source-formula history closure.

lineage_contract.method: input bulk tetrahedron ID + local vertex ordinal + native post-insertion cohesive connectivity
lineage_contract.requirements: Each declared interface face must have exactly two input parents, exactly one post-insertion bulk parent per cohesive side, paired source-node sets, equal side areas, positive area, and total area 4e-6 m2.

acceptance.full_debond_definition: all 24 native quadrature damage values reach 1 within 1e-12; a subsequent hold interval retains damage=1 and native traction norm <= 0.01*sigma_c at every quadrature point; the lower/upper bulk node sets remain disjoint and the only cross-plane element is the cohesive interface whose post-failure traction is zero.
acceptance.negative_native_dissipation: FAIL_DIAGNOSTIC_RETAIN_RAW; do not attribute it to traction orientation or relabel the state observation
acceptance.native_work_history_closure: diagnostic; any discrepancy beyond declared tolerance blocks a sign/history closure PASS
acceptance.energy_balance_and_GcA: diagnostic only; no PASS requirement for actuator energy balance or GcA
acceptance.failure_policy: If any source/shape/CFL/topology/lineage/BC gate fails, stop before or at the first failed check; no retuning and no retry.

scope_limits: central preinserted planar interface only; no free crack path or rough surface
the process-zone length is about one ninth of the minimum mesh edge; no spatial resolution claim
toy E, strength and Gc are uncalibrated and must not be spread over the vessel
no numerical solver has been run for this frozen case
no fragment lineage or positive-area parent-facet qualification has been claimed; this emits the native lineage contract for future integration
